title: Interior Designer/Architect
company: Houseberries Developers And Interior Private Limited
description:
**Job Title:** Interior Designer / Architect

**Location:** Bhagalpur, Bihar (On-site / Relocation required)

**Experience:** 1–2 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented **Interior Designer / Architect** with 1–2 years of professional experience to join our team in **Bhagalpur, Bihar**. In this role, you will handle end-to-end design tasks ranging from municipal/working 2D drafting to photo-realistic 3D visualizations, material selection, and site coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **2D Drafting & Detailing:** Develop accurate 2D architectural layouts, working drawings, furniture layouts, electrical/plumbing schemes, and detailed working drawings.
* **3D Modeling & Rendering:** Build detailed 3D interior and exterior models and produce realistic renders for client presentations.
* **Concept & Mood Boards:** Assist in material sourcing, finishes selection, color palettes, and fixture specifications.
* **Project Documentation & Collaboration:** Maintain project trackers, client presentations, design decks, and project files using Google Workspace tools.
* **Site Coordination:** Assist team members with on-site measurements, progress checks, and vendor coordination to ensure design intent aligns with execution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture (B.Arch), or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** 1–2 years of hands-on experience in residential or commercial interior/architectural projects.
* **Software Proficiency:**
* **2D Drafting:** Advanced working knowledge of **AutoCAD**.
* **3D & Rendering:** Hands-on proficiency in **SketchUp** paired with **V-Ray** (or equivalent rendering engines like Enscape/Lumion).
* **Productivity:** Comfortable with **Google Workspace** (Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides) for scheduling, documentation, and cloud collaboration.
* *Bonus:* Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop/InDesign for post-processing and presentations.
* **Location:** Must be based in or willing to **relocate to Bhagalpur, Bihar**.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong eye for spatial planning, ergonomics, lighting, and materiality.
* Ability to turn schematic concepts into accurate, construction-ready working drawings.
* Clear communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams, clients, and on-site contractors.
* Highly organized, deadline-driven, and open to feedback.

Pay: From ₹21,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Will you be able to relocate to Bhagalpur, Bihar?

Work Location: In person

title: Product Developer and Designer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and highly motivated **Mid\-Level Product Developer \& Designer** to manage the end\-to\-end design and manufacturing lifecycle of our **childrenswear and technical workwear** lines. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative design and technical execution. You will take ownership of the process from initial trend concept and **Tech Pack development** straight through to factory handoff and final fit approval. The ideal candidate has a solid foundational knowledge of garment construction, a sharp eye for functional design, and a strong understanding of apparel compliance.Key Responsibilities

* **End\-to\-End Design:** Develop original apparel concepts, mood boards, and color palettes that balance the fun, comfortable aesthetic of childrenswear with the rugged utility required for workwear.
* **Tech Pack Creation:** Build and maintain detailed, production\-ready **Tech Packs** in Adobe Illustrator and **PLM software**, including accurate flat sketches, bills of materials (BOM), stitching details, and measurement specs.
* Required Skills \& Qualifications
* **Experience:** **3 to 5 years** of professional experience in apparel product development and fashion design. Experience in kids' clothes or technical/performance wear is a major plus.
* **Software Tools:** Advanced proficiency in **Adobe Illustrator** (for technical flats/CADs) and experience utilizing **PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems**.
* **Garment Construction Knowledge:** Solid understanding of pattern making, textile properties, sewing construction, garment wash processes, and size grading.
* **Project Management:** Proven ability to manage multiple seasons simultaneously, keep tech sheets organized, and hit strict corporate calendar deadlines.
* **Portfolio:** A portfolio demonstrating strong technical capabilities, specifically featuring completed apparel tech packs, flat sketches, and photos of finished garments.

Pay: ₹200,000\.00 \- ₹350,000\.00 per year

title: Fashion Designer & Marketing Manager
description:
***JOB DESCRIPTION***

Anuprerna Artisan Alliance Pvt. Ltd. is a sustainable, tech\-enabled platform working with artisan communities across India to create handcrafted textiles, apparel, accessories, and home décor for global markets. We are looking for a Marketing Manager (Fashion \& Textile) with a strong understanding of fashion, textiles, branding, and marketing to help build and position our brand. The ideal candidate should be able to bridge the gap between design and marketing by creating compelling campaigns that effectively showcase our handcrafted products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branding**

Develop and strengthen Anuprerna's brand identity across all platforms while ensuring consistent brand communication and storytelling.

* **Marketing Strategy**

Plan and execute marketing strategies and campaigns to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and sales.

* **Fashion \& Product Development**

Work closely with the product and artisan teams to understand collections, fabrics, trends, and customer preferences, while contributing ideas for new product development and positioning.

* **Content Creation**

Create engaging content for social media, email campaigns, product descriptions, blogs, brochures, and other marketing materials.

* **Campaign Management**

Plan and manage digital marketing campaigns across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Meta, and other relevant platforms.

* **Creative Design**

Develop mood boards, campaign creatives, product mock\-ups, presentations, and marketing materials using Canva, Photoshop/Illustrator, and AI\-powered design tools.

* **Market Research**

Monitor fashion and textile industry trends, competitor activities, and consumer behaviour to identify new business opportunities.

* **Collaboration**

Coordinate with designers, photographers, content creators, artisans, and external agencies to ensure effective execution of campaigns.

* **Performance Analysis**

Track campaign performance, analyse marketing metrics, and recommend improvements to maximise engagement and conversions.

**Eligiability Criteria**

* Bachelor's degree in Fashion Design, Textile Design, Fashion Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1\+ years of experience in Fashion, Textile, Brand Marketing, or Digital Marketing (preferred).
* Strong understanding of apparel, textiles, handloom fabrics, accessories, and product development.
* Proficiency in Canva, Photoshop/Illustrator, and AI design tools.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and content writing skills in English.
* Creative mindset with strong branding and storytelling abilities.
* Passion for sustainable fashion and artisan\-led businesses.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Describe your proficiency in Canva, Photoshop/Illustrator, and AI tools.
* Share your portfolio or examples of branding, marketing campaigns, social media content, or product designs.
* Are you comfortable with our office location situated at Debipur, Memari, West Bengal?
* Describe your experience in fashion designing \& brand marketing.
* Are you comfortable with the salary range provided? or share your current remuneration.

title: Advance Power-Point & UI/UX Designer
description:
Job Summary



SAI is looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Advanced PowerPoint, Web \& UI/UX Designer** with excellent expertise in **Microsoft PowerPoint**, along with good knowledge of **Web Design and UI/UX Design**.


**Advanced PowerPoint design is a core and mandatory responsibility of this position.** Irrespective of the candidate's involvement in Web Design, UI/UX, marketing, product design, or any other project, he/she must be prepared to create, modify, redesign, and deliver professional PowerPoint presentations whenever required by the company.



The ideal candidate should be capable of transforming business ideas, product concepts, technical information, reports, dashboards, research, and raw content into visually compelling and professional presentations.



Web Design and UI/UX knowledge will be used to strengthen the candidate's overall design capability, but **PowerPoint presentation work will remain an essential part of the role.**



Mandatory PowerPoint Responsibility



The selected candidate must understand that **PowerPoint projects are compulsory for this position**.



Based on business requirements, management requests, client meetings, demonstrations, exhibitions, product launches, internal meetings, or other company activities, the employee may be required to create PowerPoint presentations at any time.



The candidate should therefore be comfortable taking complete ownership of a presentation project, including:


**Requirement**  **Content Understanding**  **Story Structure**  **Visual Concept**  **Slide Design**  **Graphics**  **Animation**  **Review**  **Final Presentation**



PowerPoint work should not be considered an occasional or secondary responsibility. It is a **regular and mandatory part of this role at SAI**.



Key Responsibilities


* Create professional, modern, and visually engaging PowerPoint presentations.
* Take complete ownership of PowerPoint projects assigned by the company.
* Be available to create or modify presentations whenever required for business purposes.
* Design executive presentations, product presentations, sales decks, client presentations, company profiles, proposals, reports, training materials, and internal presentations.
* Convert raw information, technical content, data, screenshots, and ideas into structured presentation stories.
* Convert text\-heavy and basic presentations into visually impressive professional presentations.
* Design product demonstration and technology concept presentations.
* Develop infographics, diagrams, workflows, timelines, process flows, charts, dashboards, and visual storytelling elements.
* Maintain consistency in typography, spacing, alignment, colors, branding, icons, and layouts.
* Create reusable PowerPoint templates and master slides.
* Work with Slide Master, custom layouts, themes, placeholders, and advanced formatting.
* Create professional animations, transitions, and interactive presentation experiences.
* Prepare presentations for senior management, customers, exhibitions, conferences, meetings, and product demonstrations.
* Understand the objective and audience of every presentation before starting the design.
* Work with management, product, technical, marketing, and other teams to collect information and convert it into presentation\-ready content.
